verdict.rationale: Docs confirm diff inspection ('Inspect the summary and diff') and running tasks in parallel across cloud sessions, and a native desktop app exists (referenced via ChatGPT desktop app config sharing and native app release comments). However, no evidence explicitly shows a side-by-side multi-session UI, and community reports note the desktop app is Mac-only, buggy (stuck on 'Loading projects...'), and not open source, undercutting a smooth visual review experience.
